rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something uncommon or not often encountered.

example.english: This kind of bird is rare in Hong Kong.
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 zoek3 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 hou2 siu2 gin3

rows.note: Use this for things that are sparse or thinly distributed rather than unusual.

example.english: Departures on this route are very rare at night.
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 sin3 je6 maan5 baan1 ci3 hou2 so1

rows.note: Use this specifically for meat cooked very lightly and still red inside.

example.english: I want the steak rare, with the inside still red.
example.traditional: 我要塊扒生啲，入面仲紅先好食。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jiu3 faai3 paa4 saang1 di1 jap6 min6 zung6 hung4 sin1 hou2 sik6
